moves.name: Wizard / Dorothy — right diagonal

events.text: Step right toward the right forward diagonal.
Lock left behind right and take weight.
Step right farther along that diagonal.

moves.explanation: Travel on a forward diagonal with a step, a weighted lock behind, and another step. The quick final step lands after count 2: count 1, 2&.
moves.review_note: One explicit teaching variation. Timing and foot continuity are encoded; instructor technique review is still pending.
moves.provenance_note: New event instructions and explanation authored for this project. Source links are terminology/comparison references, not copied passages or endorsements.

moves.name: Sailor 1/4 right turn — three transfers

events.text: Cross right behind left and take weight.
Turn 90 degrees right and take a small left step to the side.
Step onto right to finish, keeping the stated facing.

moves.explanation: A right-led sailor variation completes a 1/4 turn through three weight transfers on 1&2. The event list fixes where rotation occurs; do not substitute another sailor variation without checking its exit.
moves.review_note: Specified compact turning variation; the larger rotations especially require instructor and floor validation. Not an assertion that all sailors distribute rotation this way.

moves.name: Triple 1/4 right turn — RLR

events.text: Step right to the side and take weight.
Bring left beside right and take weight.
Turn 90 degrees right and step right forward in the new facing.

moves.explanation: Three weighted steps on 1&2 complete a 1/4 right turn. Follow the separate rotation on each action so the turn and ending support are explicit.
moves.review_note: This is a selected RLR turning triple; larger turns require instructor review of foot placements and available space.

moves.name: Heel jack — back, heel, close, touch

events.text: Step right slightly back and right, taking weight.
Present the left heel forward without taking weight.
Bring left back beside right and take weight.
Touch right beside left without weight.

moves.explanation: This two-count heel-jack variation presents the left heel and closes it before a final right touch. Its four actions use 1&2&; the ending is part of the variant.

moves.name: Vaudeville — cross, side, heel, close

events.text: Cross right in front of left and take weight.
Step left to the left side, taking weight.
Extend the right heel toward the right diagonal without weight.
Close right beside left and take weight.

moves.explanation: Cross, move sideways, show the free heel, then close that foot with weight. This version uses 1&2& and leaves left free.

events.text: Step right forward and take weight.
Lock left behind right and take weight.

moves.explanation: Travel forward through step, lock behind, step on 1&2. This rhythm differs from the Wizard variation even though both use three weighted actions.

events.text: Place right slightly behind left and take weight.

moves.name: Nightclub basic — side, behind-rock, recover

events.text: Take a right side step with weight and sustain it through count 1.
Place left slightly behind right and rock weight onto it.
Recover weight onto right in its current position.

moves.explanation: A sustained side step is followed by a compact behind-rock and recovery on 1, 2&. Keep this variation separate from a nightclub basic that finishes with a crossing step.

moves.name: Volta 1/4 right turn — crossing rhythm

events.text: Turn 45 degrees right and place right across the front of left with weight.

moves.name: Diamond half right — diagonal entry

events.text: Step right forward along the starting diagonal.
Turn one eighth right and step left to the side.
Turn one eighth right and step right back along the new diagonal.
Step left back on that diagonal.
Turn one eighth right and step right to the side.
Turn one eighth right and step left forward on the new diagonal.

moves.explanation: Begin facing the left forward diagonal (315 degrees from the block wall). Alternate forward and backward diagonal passages with eighth-turn side steps; finish facing the opposite diagonal after a half turn.
moves.review_note: Requires a 315-degree entry facing relative to the block wall. The side-step and diagonal transitions are explicit; instructor review of this selected diamond path is pending.
moves.provenance_note: New event instructions and explanation authored for this project. Source links are terminology/comparison references, not copied passages or endorsements.

Turn one eighth right and step left forward on the new diagonal.

moves.name: Hinge half left — two quarter-turn steps

events.text: Turn a quarter left and step right back with weight.
Turn a quarter left and step left to the side with weight.

moves.explanation: Use consecutive quarter-left turns while stepping right back and left to the side. The two weighted steps complete a half turn over two counts.
moves.review_note: This row defines a specific back-and-side hinge path. Other entry positions or turn directions require a distinct variant.

events.text: Step right forward with weight.

moves.name: Figure-eight turn — right lead, full turn, side finish

events.text: Step R to the right side and take weight on R.
Cross L behind R and take weight on L.
Turn a quarter right as R steps forward into the new facing.
Step L forward and take weight on L.
Pivot a half turn right, transferring weight from L to R.
Turn a quarter right as L steps to the left side.
Cross R behind L and take weight on R.
Step L to the left side and take weight on L.

moves.explanation: Start with R free and use one count for each listed action. This explicitly defined side-finish variant changes travel direction, completes a full rightward rotation, and ends facing the starting wall with R free; other figure-eight endings need their own instructions.
